description: This PHP script functions as an image caching proxy, fetching images from external URLs and caching them locally for a specified duration. It uses an external 'class_http.php' for HTTP requests, and outputs the fetched image directly in the response.

classes.name: http
classes.description: A class responsible for making HTTP requests, utilized here to fetch images from external URLs.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches the content from the specified URL using the provided time-to-live value.
